Get connected

3 easy steps for setting up your new mobile SIM

Select and purchase a mobile SIM plan

Add one of our mobile SIM plans to your cart and purchase it through the checkout.

Receive your sim and activate it

In 1–5 business days, receive your SIM in the mail with no postage fee and activate it online within 30 days.

Plug in your sim and you're ready to go!

Choose to keep your number or select a new one, then pop the SIM in your device and you're all set!

FAQs

Frequently asked questions about our mobile plans

Still unsure? Have a look through our most frequently asked questions, and please don't hesitate to reach out to our friendly support team if you don't see an answer to your question.

  • Aussie Broadband acts as a reseller and uses the 5G and 4G mobile network and capabilities of the Optus Mobile Network to provide our mobile services. Powered by the Optus Network, the mobile product of Aussie Broadband provides 4G coverage that reaches 98% of the Australian population. 5G coverage is being rolled out and currently only available in selected areas (excl. NT). You can check your address on our coverage map.

  • Data pooling allows all of your 5G services on the same account to combine their data and create a 'pool' that everyone can draw from.

    For example, if you've got 40GB on your plan, but your partner on the same account has a 200GB plan, then you've actually got a combined 240GB data pool to draw from.

  • An International Direct Dialling (IDD) credit is included with the following plans:

    • $50 for the 40GB plan
    • $300 for the 100GB plan
    • $200 for the 120GB plan

    IDD credit can be used to call applicable countries. For all Aussie Broadband 4G and 5G mobile plans, international calls will be charged on a PAYG (Pay As You Go) basis once any allocated IDD credit has been exhausted. Please refer to the international mobile call rates (opens in new tab) to see the call rate per country.

  • Yes, we offer International Mobile Roaming for just $5 a day to over 150 Zone 1 destinations, and pay-as-you-go rates to most other destinations.

    Visit our international roaming landing page to learn more. T&Cs apply.

  • Absolutely! You can upgrade your plan anytime by either calling our wonderful customer support team on 1300 880 905 , or by going to the MyAussie® app/portal.

  • Yes, and it's easier than you think. Once you have received your SIM, you will have the option to bring your current number over to us. Simply activate your SIM here, or call our friendly customer support team on 1300 880 905, and you will be presented with the option of porting your number.

    Please note: if you are thinking of switching from another provider and are currently in a contract, we recommend checking with them for charges associated with ending your current contract early.

  • Unfortunately, eSIM is currently not available on Aussie Broadband. However, we are working hard to add them to our product range in future. eSIM is a digital technology that allows compatible devices to connect without a physical SIM card inserted into the device.
